item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Open Gauge and Settings in the menu bar now reliably bring their window to the front, and the Gauge app menu (Check for Updates, Settings, Quit) appears while a Gauge window is open. New: Check for Updates in the popover, click an app in the popover to inspect it, opt-in alerts for apps using lots of CPU or memory, popover keyboard shortcuts, better VoiceOver labels.
